title: kaizen workflow-config
description: Persistent per-repo / user-global workflow-shape defaults — read by /kaizen:workflow, /kaizen:session-mode (as fallback), and downstream hooks.

scope.description: Which file this config came from (set by the writer; informational).

run_mode.description: Default workflow shape — routine (multi-stage), loop (Ralph), or schema (declarative DAG).

routine.description: When run_mode=routine, the routine id from routines.yaml (e.g. build-feature, fix-bug, refactor).

schema_name.description: When run_mode=schema, the schema id resolved by workflow_runner.py (e.g. onion-tdd-strict, mcp-build).

disciplines.description: Default discipline bundles enforced in future sessions. Pre-fills the session-mode intake question.

auto_handoff_threshold.description: Default auto-handoff trigger as % of context-window limit. null = disabled.

stop_conditions.description: Which exit signals are honored. Default: all four.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last write.
